recommendations.title: Schedule the development server
recommendations.description: The development server runs all day. Usage is concentrated during business hours, so stopping it overnight can reduce its running cost without changing the application.

evidence.summary: Running 24x7. Environment=dev. CPUUtilization averages 7.4% and rises during weekday business hours.
assumptions: Running the development server 12 hours a day instead of 24 hours would avoid about half of its compute cost.

recommendations.title: Release the unattached data volume
recommendations.description: This volume appears unused based on the available evidence. Confirm ownership and dependencies before deletion.

evidence.summary: Volume vol-0unattached01 is 100 GiB gp3 and its state is available, with no attachment.
assumptions: A volume with no attachment has no active workload. A snapshot may still be required before deletion.

recommendations.title: Release the unassociated Elastic IP
recommendations.description: This address appears unused based on the available evidence. Confirm it is not reserved for failover before release.

facts: No NAT Gateway or instance is attached
assumptions: An unassociated public address is billed for the full demo month.

recommendations.title: Validate the prod server before any resize
recommendations.description: Low CPU utilization does not automatically mean this instance should be downsized. The application and MySQL run on the same server. Gather memory, disk I/O, database connections, and latency before considering a smaller size.

evidence.summary: prod-app-mysql is a t3.large running the application and MySQL together. CPUUtilization averages 21.6%. Memory, disk I/O, connections, and latency were not collected.
facts: Metadata records application and MySQL on the same instance
assumptions: A smaller instance might reduce cost if memory, disk, and database load also fit. That is not established by the CPU average alone.

recommendations.title: Review snapshots older than six months
recommendations.description: Three completed snapshots started between November 2025 and January 2026. Confirm they are not required for restore before deletion.

evidence.summary: snap-0oldbackup1, snap-0oldbackup2, and snap-0oldbackup3 are completed and older than six months.
assumptions: Deleting these snapshots would remove their storage cost. Retention rules were not provided.

recommendations.title: Review the NAT path for S3 traffic
recommendations.description: This is an architecture question, not a delete recommendation. If a meaningful share of NAT traffic is headed to S3, a gateway endpoint could bypass that portion. Measure the traffic before changing the network.

evidence.summary: NAT Gateway nat-0abcd123 is available in us-east-1. No S3 gateway VPC endpoint is in the demo inventory. The share of traffic that is S3 was not measured.
facts: BytesOutToDestination average is about 1.85 GB per sample period in September 2026
No S3 gateway endpoint resource is present
assumptions: The estimate assumes part of the NAT cost is S3 traffic that a gateway endpoint could bypass. That share was not measured.
